title: Using Application::routes() causes exception
body: This is a (multiple allowed): * [x] bug * [ ] enhancement * [ ] feature-discussion (RFC) ```bash sdustinh@sdustinh:~/github/cakephp/app$ php --version PHP 7.1.16-1+ubuntu16.04.1+deb.sury.org+1 (cli) (built: Apr 5 2018 08:47:00) ( NTS ) Copyright (c) 1997-2018 The PHP Group Zend Engine v3.1.0, Copyright (c) 1998-2018 Zend Technologies with Zend OPcache v7.1.16-1+ubuntu16.04.1+deb.sury.org+1, Copyright (c) 1999-2018, by Zend Technologies with Xdebug v2.6.0, Copyright (c) 2002-2018, by Derick Rethans sdustinh@sdustinh:~/github/cakephp/app$ mysql --version mysql Ver 14.14 Distrib 5.7.22, for Linux (x86_64) using EditLine wrapper sdustinh@sdustinh:~/github/cakephp/app$ composer show cakephp/* cakephp/bake 1.7.2 Bake plugin for CakePHP 3 cakephp/cakephp 3.6.2 The CakePHP framework cakephp/cakephp-codesniffer 3.0.3 CakePHP CodeSniffer Standards cakephp/chronos 1.1.4 A simple API extension for DateTime. cakephp/debug_kit 3.15.2 CakePHP Debug Kit cakephp/elastic-search 0.3.5 An Elastic Search datasource and data mapper for CakePHP 3.0 cakephp/migrations 1.8.1 Database Migration plugin for CakePHP 3.0 based on Phinx cakephp/plugin-installer 1.1.0 A composer installer for CakePHP 3.0+ plugins. ``` ### What you did * Moved `config/routes.php` to `src/Application::routes()` * Deleted `config/routes.php` ### What happened ```bash sdustinh@sdustinh:~/github/cakephp/app$ bin/cake routes Warning Error: include(/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/config/routes.php): failed to open stream: No such file or directory in [/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/vendor/cakephp/cakephp/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172] 2018-05-01 12:53:25 Warning: Warning (2): include(/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/config/routes.php): failed to open stream: No such file or directory in [/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/vendor/cakephp/cakephp/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172] Trace: Cake\Error\BaseErrorHandler::handleError() - CORE/src/Error/BaseErrorHandler.php, line 153 include - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172 Cake\Routing\Router::_loadRoutes() - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172 Cake\Routing\Router::routes() - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1135 Cake\Shell\RoutesShell::main() - CORE/src/Shell/RoutesShell.php, line 39 Cake\Console\Shell::runCommand() - CORE/src/Console/Shell.php, line 532 Cake\Console\CommandRunner::runShell() - CORE/src/Console/CommandRunner.php, line 339 Cake\Console\CommandRunner::run() - CORE/src/Console/CommandRunner.php, line 161 [main] - ROOT/bin/cake.php, line 10 Warning Error: include(): Failed opening '/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/config/routes.php' for inclusion (include_path='.:/usr/share/php') in [/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/vendor/cakephp/cakephp/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172] 2018-05-01 12:53:25 Warning: Warning (2): include(): Failed opening '/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/config/routes.php' for inclusion (include_path='.:/usr/share/php') in [/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/vendor/cakephp/cakephp/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172] Trace: Cake\Error\BaseErrorHandler::handleError() - CORE/src/Error/BaseErrorHandler.php, line 153 include - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172 Cake\Routing\Router::_loadRoutes() - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172 Cake\Routing\Router::routes() - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1135 Cake\Shell\RoutesShell::main() - CORE/src/Shell/RoutesShell.php, line 39 Cake\Console\Shell::runCommand() - CORE/src/Console/Shell.php, line 532 Cake\Console\CommandRunner::runShell() - CORE/src/Console/CommandRunner.php, line 339 Cake\Console\CommandRunner::run() - CORE/src/Console/CommandRunner.php, line 161 [main] - ROOT/bin/cake.php, line 10 +------------+--------------+----------+ | Route name | URI template | Defaults | +------------+--------------+----------+ ``` ### What you expected to happen Application routes to be loaded via `Application::routes()`. In addition to routes not being available via `bin/cake routes` they don't seem to be loaded when the page loads either. I end up getting errors like this: ```bash Warning (2): include(/home/sdustinh/github/cakephp/app/config/routes.php) [function.include]: failed to open stream: No such file or directory [CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172] Code Context static::$initialized = true; include CONFIG . 'routes.php'; } include - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172 Cake\Routing\Router::_loadRoutes() - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 1172 Cake\Routing\Router::url() - CORE/src/Routing/Router.php, line 611 Cake\View\View::uuid() - CORE/src/View/View.php, line 1088 Jira\View\Helper\JiraBugReportHelper::beforeLayout() - ROOT/plugins/Jira/src/View/Helper/JiraBugReportHelper.php, line 36 Cake\Event\EventManager::_callListener() - CORE/src/Event/EventManager.php, line 353 Cake\Event\EventManager::dispatch() - CORE/src/Event/EventManager.php, line 330 Cake\View\View::dispatchEvent() - CORE/src/Event/EventDispatcherTrait.php, line 114 Cake\View\View::renderLayout() - CORE/src/View/View.php, line 841 Cake\View\View::render() - CORE/src/View/View.php, line 808 Cake\Controller\Controller::render() - CORE/src/Controller/Controller.php, line 777 Cake\Error\ExceptionRenderer::_outputMessage() - CORE/src/Error/ExceptionRenderer.php, line 329 Cake\Error\ExceptionRenderer::_outputMessage() - CORE/src/Error/ExceptionRenderer.php, line 338 Cake\Error\ExceptionRenderer::render() - CORE/src/Error/ExceptionRenderer.php, line 205 Cake\Error\Middleware\ErrorHandlerMiddleware::handleException() - CORE/src/Error/Middleware/ErrorHandlerMiddleware.php, line 118 Cake\Error\Middleware\ErrorHandlerMiddleware::__invoke() - CORE/src/Error/Middleware/ErrorHandlerMiddleware.php, line 100 Cake\Http\Runner::__invoke() - CORE/src/Http/Runner.php, line 65 ``` Adding `Router::$initialized = true;` suppresses the error in the browser, but still results in a 500. With all of these changes it is very likely that I missed a step in the migration guide but it seems that there is a miscommunication between the `Router` and `RoutingMiddleware` so I figured it would be easy enough to open an issue about.
